page.overview:
Who is Martian Man?

Aquarus † War Woman † Green Ghost † Red Rush † Darkwing † Black Samson Damien Darkblood Nikki

Martian Man was a Martian exiled on Earth and an original member of the Guardians of the Globe. He died alongside most of his colleagues when the Guardians were betrayed by Omni-Man.

Long before his arrival on Earth, Martian Man was exiled from Mars by his own race, the exact circumstances of which are entirely unknown. Taking refuge on Earth, he used shapeshifting to assume the identity of a normal human and lived in hiding until he decided to reveal his existence to the world, leading the GDA to induct him into the Guardians of the Globe. Wishing to explore his latent humanity further, Martian Man also befriended and cared for a young girl, Nikki.

Martian Man and the other Guardians of the Globe, arrive at the White House to protect the U.S. President from a sudden attack by the Mauler Twins.
